notes.title: WHERE IS A TOILET update a special mod map for Christmas!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1KY9vfP.png[/img]

WHERE IS A TOILET!? has a special update for Christmas!

The update as below:

[list]
[*] You can select a special mod named : CHRISTMAS SPECIAL MAP
[*] In this special map, you play as Santa Claus.
[*] Gathering present, stomp the cookie enemies.
[*] The record in this map is not recordable.
[/list]


Enjoy the special map and Merry Christmas!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/uhxNibu.png[/img]
